list.description: The period of each bar. Auto uses days up to 100 days, weeks up to two years, and months after that.
list.label: Group bars by
list.name: Group

list.definition: SELECT CASE WHEN ${Group:sqlstring} <> 'auto' THEN ${Group:sqlstring} WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '100 days' THEN 'day' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '730 days' THEN 'week' ELSE 'month' END
list.name: Bucket

panels.description: Average over the complete days in the time range. Today counts after it ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg("restingHeartRate") AS "Value"
FROM garmin.usersummary
WHERE "calendarDate" BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND "calendarDate" < (now() AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date

panels.title: Body Battery charged per day

panels.description: Dots are single days. The line is the average of the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, "Resting HR", "7-day average"
FROM (SELECT "calendarDate", "calendarDate"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, "restingHeartRate" AS "Resting HR", avg("restingHeartRate") OVER (ORDER BY "calendarDate" RANGE BETWEEN interval '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "7-day average"
FROM garmin.usersummary
WHERE "calendarDate" BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 6 AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND "calendarDate" < (now() AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS days
WHERE "calendarDate" >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resting heart rate

panels.description: Dots are single nights. The line is the 7-day average. The band is your baseline range. Garmin calculates all three.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "calendarDate"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, "lastNightAvg" AS "Last night", "weeklyAvg" AS "7-day average", "balancedLow" AS "Baseline low", "balancedUpper" AS "Baseline high"
FROM garmin."hrvSummary"
WHERE "calendarDate" BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Average per day in each bar. Group bars by sets the bar period. Day totals exclude today.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc(${Bucket:sqlstring}, "calendarDate"::timestamp) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, avg("restStressDuration") AS "Rest", avg("lowStressDuration") AS "Low", avg("mediumStressDuration") AS "Medium", avg("highStressDuration") AS "High"
FROM garmin.usersummary
WHERE "calendarDate" >= date_trunc(${Bucket:sqlstring}, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date::timestamp) AND "calendarDate" <= ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND "calendarDate" < (now() AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "calendarDate"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, "vo2MaxPreciseValue" AS "VO2 max"
FROM garmin.maxmet
WHERE key = 'generic' AND "calendarDate" BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date
ORDER BY 1
